title: A stranger at the gate

stage.nudge: Someone footsore is coming up the road behind you.

text: {stranger}, come up from {from}, reaches the gate footsore and penniless. They have news, they say: {news}. They'd tell it all for a bite to eat.

effects.text: Over bread and broth {stranger} tells you everything: {news}. "If you're ever in {from}, ask for me."
{stranger} nods and limps on toward the inn, still talking: {news}.

choices.label: Tell them to move along
choices.deed: turned {stranger} from {from} away at the gate

effects.text: {stranger} spits in the dust and goes in without you.
